name: out-of-bounds-write
title: Reject writes past the end of a buffer
lesson: Index 16 is outside a 16-byte buffer because the last valid index is 15.
fix_goal: Check writes with index < capacity before touching the buffer.
fix_steps: Use a strict less-than capacity check.
Reject index values equal to or greater than the capacity.
Re-run the lab and confirm the bad write is rejected.
